title: Judge and segments build plan
approval: Build plan approved: judge blocking fix and one-minute segments

short.lead: The build is eight steps, one issue each under issue #605 (Roadblock judge tuning and one-minute segments), starting with the written criteria. I need your approval to begin step 1 (#606, the written criteria).
short.hint: Tap a step to see how we will know it is done.
items: Write the five criteria (C1 to C5), the standard a reason must meet, and the six allowed reply forms into rules/detail/roadblocks.md
Done when: `rules/detail/roadblocks.md` holds C1 to C5 and the six forms, `checks.json` maps the section, and the core part of `verify.py` shows no new failure.

items.alt: Build order: 606 first, then 607 and 609, then 608 and 610; 611 and 612 can start any time; 613 last
items.caption: Which issue needs which before it can start.

items: Move the judge into the scripted Stop hook

Done when: `hooks.json` has no prompt-type entry on the Stop hook; a test case that uses a stand-in for Claude shows a flagged reply gets a block naming a criterion, and a reply that meets C1 to C5 is left alone.
One shared cap of two blocks with a reset
Done when: a test case replays 12 identical flagged replies and sees at most 2 blocks, followed by a warning; a second case with a tool call between blocks sees the check run again.
Narrow the phrase lists that cause false alarms, and write block messages that show what a passing reply looks like
Done when: Cases show a reply ending in a next step passes, an Unverified line passes, and a block message names a criterion and shows the six forms.
The segment plan, 60-second deadlines and the launch guard

Done when: guard test cases show that a 280-second launch is refused with a form to copy; the same launch with a valid `Cannot split:` reason passes; a generic reason is refused; and a known long-running tool launched with no timeout is treated as running over 60 seconds.
verify.py prints each part as it finishes; the modular-tests gate and audit flag modules over 60 seconds
Done when: `verify.py` output shows a fast part finishing before a slower part that started earlier; a flagged module appears in the audit output with its time.
The page check reads picture markup correctly and the page build refuses a malformed picture
Done when: a test case feeds the check a page with an inline picture and expects no findings from it; another feeds a picture containing a raw angle bracket and expects the page build to refuse it.
Docs, changelog, version, decisions entry and a replay of 12 blocked replies

Done when: The changelog line and version exist, the decisions entry is dated, `verify.py` exits 0 from a checkout path like the CI runner's, and the replay of 12 blocked replies shows at most 2 blocks.
